name: manage_media_pool
description:
Organize the media pool library using user-managed folders.

Use this for Finder/NLE-style organization only: list folders, create bins, rename bins, move assets into bins, or rename how assets appear in the media pool. It does not edit the timeline and it does not change source media content.

action.description: list, create_folder, rename_folder, delete_empty_folder, move_assets, rename_asset

assetIds.description: Comma-separated asset prefix IDs for move_assets/rename_asset

folderPath.description: Folder path such as Master/B-roll, or folder id prefix

name.description: New folder name for create_folder; cannot contain "/"

newName.description: New folder or asset display name for rename actions; folder names cannot contain "/"

parentPath.description: Parent folder path for create_folder, defaults to Master

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

targetPath.description: Destination folder path for move_assets, defaults to Master
